# aioswitcher

> PyPi module integrating with various Switcher devices.

The complete documentation is also available as a single file: [llms-full.txt](https://aioswitcher.figenblat.com/llms-full.txt).

## Getting started

- [Install](<https://aioswitcher.figenblat.com/install/index.md>): Installation instructions

## Usage

- [Bridge](<https://aioswitcher.figenblat.com/usage_bridge/index.md>): Device discovery over UDP broadcast
- [API](<https://aioswitcher.figenblat.com/usage_api/index.md>): Device control over TCP

## Supported devices

- [Supported devices](<https://aioswitcher.figenblat.com/supported/index.md>): Table of supported Switcher devices

## Code documentation

- [Code documentation](<https://aioswitcher.figenblat.com/codedocs/index.md>): Auto-generated API reference

## Helper scripts

- [Helper scripts](<https://aioswitcher.figenblat.com/scripts/index.md>): CLI helper scripts shipped with the package
